summary: Multi-Chain Copy Trading and Signal Analytics backend testing complete. All 24 tests passed. Multi-chain copy trading supports Solana, Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum with wallet linking, multi-chain follow settings, unified leaderboard, and cross-chain stats. Signal Analytics provides 359 signals analyzed with strategy comparison (combined: 43.6, mean_reversion: 40.7, momentum: 32.0 quality scores) and optimal settings recommendations.
